senses.gloss:
m. (-मिः)
1 A worm, an insect in general.
2 Lac, the red dye, which is in fact an insect.
5 An Asura or demon.
4 One subject to worms.
E.
क्रम to go, इन् Uṇādi affix, and the corresponding vowel substituted for र; also किमि.

n. (-कं)
1 A plant used in medicine: see बिडङ्ग.
2 Opposite leaved fig tree.
3 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata): see मूषिकपर्णी.
E.
कृमि a worm, and कण्टक a thorn, a foe; also क्रिमिकण्ठक.

m. (-र्णः)
Worms or lice generating in the external ear.
E.
कृमि, and कर्ण the ear.

mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं)
Silken, silk.
E.
कृमि a worm, कोश a ball, and उत्थ what comes or rises from.

m. (-न्थिः)
Insects generated at the roots of the eyelashes.
E.
कृमि, and ग्रन्थि a joint.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Vermifuge, anthelmintic.
m. (-घ्नः)
1 A shrub used in medicine, as an anthelmintic, commonly Bireṅg, (Erycibe paniculata, Rox.) see बिडङ्ग.
2 The onion.
3 The root of the jujube.
4 The marking nut plant.
f. (-घ्नी)
Turmeric.
E.
कृमि a worm, हन् to kill, and टक् affix; also क्रिमिघ्न.

n. (-जं)
Agallochum: see क्रिमिज.
f. (-जा)
Lac, a red dye so called.
E.
कृमि an insect, and ज born, produced.

m. (-कः)
Toothache with decay of the teeth.
E.
कृमि, and दन्त a tooth, कन् added.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Affected with worms.
E.
कृमि, and इनि aff.

n. (-पुः)
An anthelmintic plant: see कृमिघ्न.
E.
कृमि, and रिपु an enemy.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Having worms, wormy.
f. (-ला)
A fruitful woman, one bearing many children.
E.
कृमि a worm, and ला to receive, to get, affix ड.

m. (-ङ्खः)
The fish of the conch.
E.
कृमि a worm, and शङ्ख a shell.

f. (-क्तिः)
An oyster.
E.
कृमि an insect, and शुक्ति oyster-shell.

m. (-लः)
An ant or mole hill.
E.
कृमि a worm, and शैल a hill; also with कन् added, कृमिशैलक.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Anthelmintic, vermifuge.
E.
कृमि, and हर what removes; so कृमिहन्तृ (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ.)

m. (-कः)
A wild sort of kidney bean: see बनमुद्ग.
